name: Air Street Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Air Street Capital (airstreet.com), the AI-first venture firm founded in 2019 and run by solo GP Nathan Benaich; site footer names Air Street Capital Management Ltd.; it publishes Air Street Press (press.airstreet.com) and the State of AI Report. TechCrunch calls it 'London's Air Street Capital'. The user-list lead '2026 fund $232M' matches the $232,323,232 Fund III announced 2026-03-23. Fund vehicles: Air Street Capital I LP (Companies House LP019858, registered 2018, Guernsey address), Air Street Capital II LP and Air Street Capital III LP (EDGAR Form D index, St. Peter Port). Not Air Street Films, Air Street Services, Air Street Management Ltd (Southport), Air Street Consultants (Manchester) or Air Street Store (Brighton) on Companies House.

thesis_text.value: Solo-GP firm run by founder Nathan Benaich that backs only AI-first companies, where AI is the core of the product, from the earliest stages in Europe and North America. Leads early rounds with $0.5-15M checks plus occasional growth checks up to $25M, across frontier models, AI infrastructure and developer tools, agents, robotics and autonomy, defense and techbio.
